---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new method, dataset, or analysis
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you proposing**
A clear description of the feature or change.

**Why it matters**
What real gap does this fill? If this is a new dataset or detection
method, link to the source or paper and explain what it adds to the
comparison.

**Is the damage state known**
For a new dataset, note whether the dates and nature of damage or other
structural changes are documented independently of the measurements.
Without that, detections and false alarms cannot be counted.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about and why you did not pick them.
